# Social Dev Technologies

> Social Dev Technologies teaches practical Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent building through guided, hands-on sessions using Claude. Students follow step-by-step builds - copy-paste prompts, real integrations (Gmail, Slack, Notion, WhatsApp, and more), and a portfolio write-up at the end of each session - rather than watching passive video lectures.

Social Dev Technologies is not a general AI-literacy or prompt-engineering course. Every session ends with a working, shippable agent and a portfolio artifact. Students need their own paid Claude account (Claude Pro or higher, billed separately by Anthropic) to follow along.

## Program structure

- **Builder 1** - 12 guided sessions covering foundational agent builds (email triage, chat bots, automation basics).
- **Builder 2** - 13 guided sessions covering more advanced, multi-step agent builds.
- **Pro** - bundles Builder 1 and Builder 2 together.
- All plans are one-time payments for 6 months of access. Cohorts run on scheduled start dates shown on the pricing page.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/): overview, stats, and how the program works.
- [Catalog](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/catalog): browse all sessions by department and difficulty.
- [Learning paths](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/paths): department-organized learning tracks.
- [Pricing](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/pricing): Builder 1 / Builder 2 / Pro plans, cohort start dates.
- [About](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/about): mission, teaching principles, who the program is for.
- [FAQ](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/faq): access, refunds, certificates, payment methods, prerequisites.
- [Sitemap](https://socialdevtechnologies.com/sitemap.xml): full list of indexable pages, including every individual session guide.

## Outcomes

Completing sessions earns XP and, at defined proficiency thresholds, an auto-issued, publicly verifiable certificate (verification pages live under `/verify-certificate/:id`).
